What is Clearscope?

Premium content optimisation platform positioned at the enterprise end of the market. Deliberately simpler than competitors - it focuses on content grading, term coverage and readability, with a reputation for accuracy and clean reports.

Best for

Clean, reliable content grading for teams with an editorial process.

Main features

  • Content reports grading a draft A++ to F against top-ranking competitors
  • term and topic coverage recommendations with usage frequency guidance
  • readability grading
  • content inventory tracking performance of all your pages over time
  • keyword discovery
  • Google Docs and WordPress add-ons for in-tool grading
  • monthly content performance monitoring
  • shareable reports for briefing writers
  • team collaboration.

Practical use cases

  • Grading a draft before publication against a clear standard
  • briefing external writers with a shareable, unambiguous target report
  • tracking whether optimised pages actually improved over time
  • maintaining editorial quality across a large content team.

Who is it for?

  • Enterprise content teams, well-funded agencies, and publishers with mature content operations.

Pricing, free access & limits

Subscription by content reports and seats

Plans described in the source

Essentials around $189/mo with roughly 20 content reports/month, 1 seat and limited keyword discovery. Business around $399/mo with more reports, multiple seats and content inventory. Enterprise custom, annual, with high report volumes, unlimited seats and dedicated support. Annual billing discounted. Clearscope is the most expensive entry point among the content optimisation tools here.

Free plan

No free plan.

Free trial

Demo and limited trials via sales; no standing self-serve trial.

Usage limits to consider

Metered by content reports per month - each keyword report consumes one. Seat counts tier-limited. Keyword discovery volumes tier-limited.

Strengths & tradeoffs

These points summarize the supplied research, rather than hands-on test results.

Strengths noted in the source

  • The cleanest and most trustworthy reports in this category - the A++ to F grading is unambiguous, which makes it excellent for briefing external writers
  • deliberately narrow scope means it does one thing very well with no feature bloat
  • term recommendations are more accurate and less noisy than competitors
  • excellent Google Docs integration.

Limitations to consider

  • By far the most expensive option here at roughly $189/mo entry for 20 reports - hard to justify below enterprise scale
  • deliberately limited feature set means no AI writing, no technical SEO, no rank tracking, no internal linking
  • report metering is restrictive at the entry tier
  • no self-serve trial makes evaluation slow
  • the same over-optimisation risk as Surfer applies.

Platforms, languages & integrations

Platforms

  • Web, Google Docs add-on, WordPress plugin, Chrome extension

Languages

  • Supports multiple languages and Google locales including French; Arabic coverage is limited

API access

Yes - Clearscope API available

Integrations and exports

  • Google Docs, WordPress, Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Zapier, Contentful

Evaluation notes

Clearscope's value is editorial governance across a team, not individual productivity - a solo writer will not justify the price. The shareable report as a writer brief is the feature that pays for itself in agency and publisher settings.
